newsitem.title: USA: Systems Communications CEO Williams resigns.
newsitem.headline: Systems Communications CEO Williams resigns.

text.p: Systems Communications Inc said Wednesday that it has accepted the resignation of Stephen Williams, president and chief executive officer and Edwin Salmon, senior vice president.
The company did not give any reasons for the resignations.

Systems Communications board of directors said it has voted to replace Williams with Douglas Drumwright, a partner in the turnaround firm of Alpha Partners, who has extensive experience in the health care industry and in returning companies to profitability.
No replacement for Salmon was announced.
The company also said that Alpha Partners has been retained to reestablish it on a sound financial footing and to provide a plan to take advantage of the potential of SCI's operating companies.
